concept.title: Why your account is locked, and how to unlock it
concept.shortdesc: Ledgerly locks an account after ten wrong passwords in a row. The lock protects your books from someone guessing your password, and it lifts on its own.

section.title: How long the lock lasts
section.p: The first lock lasts 15 minutes. If wrong passwords continue after that, each new lock lasts twice as long as the one before, up to 24 hours. A correct password after the lock lifts resets the count.

ul.li: Wait 15 minutes, and then sign in with the right password. This is the quickest way in most cases.
Reset your password if you aren't sure of it. A password reset unlocks the account at once. See Reset your password.
Ask an administrator. An administrator of your company's Ledgerly account can unlock you from Settings > Users. They can't see or set your password.

section.title: If you didn't enter those passwords
section.p: Someone else tried to sign in as you. Reset your password, and then turn on two-step verification under Your account > Security if it isn't on already. You can also see the attempts, with their time and approximate location, under Your account > Sign-in activity.
